description: Gather information about a Pacemaker cluster.
examples:
- name: Gather Pacemaker cluster info
  community.general.pacemaker_info:
  register: result

- name: Debug cluster info
  ansible.builtin.debug:
    msg: "{{ result }}"

return_values.name: cluster_info
return_values.description: Cluster information such as the name, UUID, and nodes. Returned: always

return_values.name: constraint_info
return_values.description: All cluster resource constraints on the cluster. Returned: success

return_values.name: property_info
return_values.description: All properties present on the cluster. Returned: success

return_values.name: resource_info
return_values.description: All resources available on the cluster and their status. Returned: success

return_values.name: stonith_info
return_values.description: All STONITH information on the cluster. Returned: success
